messages:
lina: Thanks for the postmortem draft on the cache outage. Quick proposal: create a short-lived 'remediation escrow' for every action item so ownership doesn't evaporate after PM review. Basic idea: owner + fallback + escrow expiry + auto-reminders. Thoughts?

Tom: Sounds useful. Can we enforce a minimal validation step before closing an escrow? e.g., "smoke test + metric check" recorded on the ticket.

rahul: Agreed. Also, let's tag recurring incidents at creation time (recurrence:service-cache) so the tracker can surface patterns automatically. If a tag hits 3 occurrences in 45 days, escalate to a recurrence review.

emily: For comms cadence: when an action is created, bot should post to #eng-oncall with 1-line summary: "Action: <short> — owner — ETA — blocker" and then post brief progress updates every 72 hours until closed. Keep the updates in-channel and on the ticket.

lina: Example escrow schema I'm thinking of:
```
owner: @<owner>
fallback: @<fallback>
escrowal_expiry: YYYY-MM-DD
priority: P0/P1/P2
verify: metric_name < threshold or smoke test link
recurrence_tag: e.g., cache-timeout-v3
blockers: free text
notes: rollout/feature flag/rollback notes
```

Tom: Add an "IC observer" field so the next shift's IC gets visibility during handoff. That should close the loop on follow-ups slipping between oncall shifts.

rahul: Ops automation idea: Have the tracker emit a weekly digest to the SRE leads with open escrows older than X days and recurrence candidates. That helps PMs prioritize longer-term fixes.

ops-bot: [reminder] Action 2201234567-1 (owner: @tom) due in 24h — pinging fallback @rahul.

emily: Let's pilot for 3 weeks on infra services only. Lina, can you draft the pilot plan? Include: pilot board, reminder cadence, closing criteria, and success metrics (time-to-closure, % actions with verification).

lina: Yep. I'll put a pilot board together and post the README + schema by Fri.

Tom: I'll add the IC-observer changes to the handoff doc and update the oncall playbook.

rahul: I'll add recurrence tagging and the 3-in-45-days escalation rule to the tracker automation.

emily: Can we have a quick 20-min demo next Tue to review the pilot board? I can host.

lina: Scheduled. I'll DM calendar invite. Please drop one-line updates in this thread during pilot.

Tom: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/escrow-tracker/pull/7 — includes fields + webhook for reminders.

rahul: Drafted recurrence rule in alerts repo: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/compare/recur-rule — feedback welcome.

lina: Thanks team — aim is to reduce "forgotten postmortems" and surface recurring failures sooner. We'll reconvene after pilot for roll decision. :rocket:
